CUV uses 耶和华 for the Tetragrammaton (YHWH) and 神 for Elohim — preserved as in the official text; generic 'Deus' rendered 神 per rules. 67:5a '(fit reverentia)' rubric = 行礼致敬. 67:28a 'in mentis excéssu' (LXX/Vulgate; not in CUV Ps 68) rendered 心神超拔. A few half-verses (e.g. 62:10, 63:14b 'Accédet homo ad cor altum') carry Vulgate readings divergent from MT/CUV; rendered to match the Vulgate sense while drawing CUV wording where parallel.
